summary: In this video, Neff Gaming conducts a 300 Reversal Summon session targeting the guaranteed legendary hero Child of Chaos. During the summons, multiple legendary heroes drop, including Talwer, Sagomir, Oggok, Torrin, Ripekas, and three duplicates of Solmo. The session successfully yields the 300-summon milestone guarantee for Child of Chaos while allowing Solmo to be upgraded to Inspiration 5.

heroes.name: Child of Chaos
heroes.note: Obtained by reaching the 300 accumulated summon milestone on the Reversal Banner.

heroes.name: Solmo
heroes.note: Provides shields, buffs, radiant damage, and debuff dispels; reaching Inspiration 5 grants enhanced shield scaling and bonus stats.

heroes.name: Talwer
heroes.note: Obtained during the 300 reversal summons session.

heroes.name: Sagomir
heroes.note: Obtained during a double legendary pull.

heroes.name: Oggok
heroes.note: Obtained alongside Sagomir in a double legendary pull.

heroes.name: Torrin
heroes.note: Obtained during the reversal summoning session.

heroes.name: Ripekas
heroes.note: Obtained near the end of the summoning session.

tips: The Reversal Banner stays available for two weeks, so players have time to test the hero and save resources before deciding to pull.
